title: Beginner Home Workout
content: Choose a few comfortable bodyweight movements such as squats, wall or knee push-ups, and a short plank. Start with one easy round, rest between movements, and increase gradually as you become comfortable.
keywords: beginner home bodyweight full body squats push-ups lunges plank

title: Beginner Chest Workout
content: Explore wall push-ups, incline push-ups, or knee push-ups. Choose an option you can control comfortably, rest between sets, and stop if you feel pain.
keywords: beginner chest push-ups home upper body

title: Gym Chest Workout
content: Bench press, incline dumbbell press, and cable flyes are examples of chest exercises. Learn the movement with a qualified trainer and choose a manageable resistance.
keywords: gym chest bench press dumbbell cable strength

title: Beginner Leg Workout
content: Try comfortable bodyweight squats, supported lunges, glute bridges, and calf raises. Start gently, rest between movements, and build up gradually.
keywords: beginner legs lower body squats lunges glutes calves

title: Pomodoro Study Technique
content: Focus on one topic for 25 minutes, then take a 5-minute break. After four sessions, take a longer break. Adjust the session length if that helps you stay focused.
keywords: pomodoro focus concentration time management breaks

title: Active Recall
content: Close your notes and explain the topic from memory. Use questions or flashcards to test yourself, then check the gaps in your understanding.
keywords: active recall memory flashcards revision test exam

title: Avoiding Procrastination
content: Break your work into a very small first task that takes about five minutes. A clear first step makes it easier to begin.

title: Consistent Sleep Routine
content: Try to sleep and wake at approximately the same times each day. A simple, consistent routine can make your evenings easier to manage.
keywords: routine schedule bedtime wake tired sleep cycle

title: Reducing Screen Use
content: Set work aside before bedtime, dim bright lights, and choose a relaxing activity as part of your wind-down routine.

title: Improving the Sleep Environment
content: Make your room dark, quiet, and comfortable. Notice which habits, such as late caffeine, affect your own sleep.
keywords: room dark quiet temperature caffeine environment

title: Balanced Meal Guide
content: Use vegetables or fruit, a protein source, a staple carbohydrate, and some fat to build a varied meal. Adapt it to your preferences and any advice you already follow.
keywords: balanced meal food vegetables fruit protein carbohydrates fat

title: Healthy Student Snack
content: Convenient snack options include fruit, yoghurt, nuts, eggs, or whole-grain toast. Pick options that suit your budget and dietary needs.
keywords: student snack healthy fruit yoghurt nuts eggs budget

title: Daily Hydration
content: Keep water nearby and drink regularly through your day. You may need more during exercise or hot weather; follow any personal fluid guidance you have been given.
keywords: water hydration thirsty exercise weather drink
